output.summary: CMO Master Governance & Strategic Sign-Off: Approved the developer-centric positioning and controlled experimental roadmap for Ollama (PROD_OLLAMA_LOCAL_AI). Execution remains strictly in SUPERVISED autonomy mode, requiring human business owner approval prior to external publishing and any paid media commitments.

commercial_strategy_synthesis.core_positioning: Streamlined CLI and localhost REST API daemon (localhost:11434) runtime layer for local open-weight model execution across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
commercial_strategy_synthesis.primary_wedge: Elimination of manual C++ inference and CUDA compilation friction.
governed_trade_offs: Do NOT market as an enterprise high-throughput production cluster replacement without explicit host VRAM prerequisites.
Do NOT run broad non-technical consumer paid ad spend; reserve media capacity for technical developer cohorts.
Do NOT claim proprietary AI model benchmark leadership; focus strictly on orchestration UX and hardware boundary transparency.

grounded_facts: Ollama executes open-weight models locally via CLI and REST API daemon on localhost:11434 (EVID-WEB-893338BD, EVID-WEB-2BAE59D7).
Hardware boundaries: 7B Q4 models require ~4-5GB VRAM, 14B models require ~8-10GB; exceeding GPU VRAM triggers CPU fallback latency (EVID-WEB-2BAE59D7, CONF-40334167).
Multi-OS availability across macOS, Linux, and Windows binary installers (EVID-WEB-893338BD).
Developer community setup friction centered on manual C++ compilation (EVID-FORUM-F119C750).
strategic_inferences: STRAT-001: Developer runtime positioning provides sustainable utility over cloud APIs for local-first workflows.
STRAT-002: Friction reduction wedge drives faster developer time-to-first-token.
STRAT-005: Offline architecture teardowns attract privacy-conscious engineering teams.
hypotheses_under_test: PEXP-001: Setup friction hook (VAR-A) outperforms REST API specificity (VAR-B) in 3-second developer retention.
PEXP-002: Upfront model-to-VRAM hardware qualification CTA (VAR-C) pre-qualifies developers and improves downstream activation.
PEXP-003: Technical search capture ('run llama locally') generates high-intent documentation depth and installation intent.

primary_go: CHAN-DEV-SOCIAL (Technical video demonstrations of CLI/API on port 11434)
deferred_hold: CHAN-ENTERPRISE-OUTBOUND (Deferred pending enterprise compliance tier and transaction data)

governance_and_approval_controls.stop_loss_policy: Halt variant immediately if bounce rate increases >20% or if cost per download exceeds established thresholds.
human_approval_gates: Ad network budget allocation and spend activation require HUMAN_BUSINESS_OWNER_APPROVAL.
Public external asset publishing requires HUMAN_BUSINESS_OWNER_APPROVAL.

confidence_rationale: High epistemic confidence in technical product capabilities and developer pain points supported by direct documentation and forum evidence; confidence is bounded to MEDIUM due to missing transaction data, unmeasured unit economics (CAC, LTV, ROAS), and absent representative telemetry.
unknown_facts: CAC = UNKNOWN (Requires media spend and verified install attribution)
LTV = UNKNOWN (Requires monetization tier and transaction history)
hypotheses: Friction-focused terminal setup hook (VAR-A) outperforms generic announcements in 3s hook retention.
Localhost REST API specificity hook (VAR-B) drives higher technical documentation depth.
Upfront VRAM compatibility CTA (VAR-C) pre-qualifies traffic and increases downstream CLI installation completion.
Technical search capture on exact-match queries ('run llama locally') drives qualified developer traffic with viable CPID.
next_action: Submit GroundedCMOGovernancePackage to Human Business Owner for budget parameter authorization and sign-off on PEXP-001/PEXP-002 experimental flighting.
